name: Healthy CI
outcome: The repository has native continuous integration that matches its verified commands and can be repaired when it fails.
constraints: Use the repository's actual package manager, runtime, and commands.
Preserve existing CI and explicit repository security policy unless the approved request permits a change.
Do not declare success until the proposed commit passes its real CI checks.

criteria: The repository-native CI runs on pull requests and the default branch.
Every generated command has been verified against the repository.
The generated CI passes on the proposed commit.
Ordinary CI does not depend on Kody or the Store.
